newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity down in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity down in Feb.

text.p: Construction activity in Lebanon continued a downward trend in February, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin issued on Tuesday.

"Construction performance continued its downward trend as the area of construction permits approved in February by Association of Engineers declined by 47.5 percent compared to last year," the bank said.
Cement deliveries fell to 161,000 tonnes in February, declining by 24.7 percent on a year-on-year basis. Deliveries were 239 thousand tonnes last month.
Total real estate fees collected dropped to 12.8 billion pounds from 17.1 a month earlier, the report added.
($1 = 1,547.75 Lebanese pounds at end of February)
